name: Project Plan
description: Phased project plan compiled from the project memory: phases and activities drafted by AI from the artifact model and indexed material (clearly AI-proposed, user-owned), while every date, deadline, dimension and document reference is a cited fact or [MANGLER]. Known issues (rev conflicts, open TQs, hazards) are pulled from the index as risk items. Sequencing and priorities are planning judgment — author placeholders mark where the human decides.

required_facts.label: Objective / scope as stated in sources
required_facts.label_no: Mål/omfang slik det fremgår av kildene

sections.title: Phases & Activities
sections.notes: AI drafts phases from artifact lifecycle + document types present (design → søknad → utførelse → ferdigstillelse patterns). Every activity referencing a spec/dimension/document cites it. Section carries the 'AI-foreslått struktur' banner; '[AUTHOR: bekreft rekkefølge og ansvar]' per phase — sequencing is planning judgment, not extraction.

sections.title: Milestones & Dates
sections.notes: Table: milepæl | dato | kilde | status. ONLY dates that exist as facts (deadlines, document dates, permit dates) — planned future dates the user hasn't stated render as [MANGLER: dato — angi] rows the user fills. The engine never invents a schedule.

sections.title: Risks & Open Items
sections.notes: Code+AI hybrid: rows compiled from what the index already knows — revision conflicts (drawings register), open TQs (spec review docs), hazards/warnings (facts), unresolved MANGLER across sibling documents. Each row cites its source. Mitigation column = author placeholder.

sections.title: Document Deliverables
sections.notes: Which documents this project needs/has: existing project documents (from the project's document list) + completeness suggestions (detect_suggestions) as proposed rows marked 'foreslått'. The plan becomes the natural home for the suggestion engine's output.

sections.title: Declaration
sections.boilerplate: This plan was compiled from the sources listed in the Source Register; dates, dimensions and references are cited facts. Phasing, sequencing and priorities are proposals requiring the project owner's judgment and confirmation. This document is a planning aid, not a contractual schedule.
sections.boilerplate_no: Denne planen er sammenstilt fra kildene i kilderegisteret; datoer, dimensjoner og referanser er siterte fakta. Fasedeling, rekkefølge og prioriteringer er forslag som krever prosjekteiers vurdering og bekreftelse. Dokumentet er et planleggingsverktøy, ikke en kontraktsfestet fremdriftsplan.
